visual.description: Pure black used as the primary page and hero background throughout the site.
Near-black used for section surfaces and secondary backgrounds.
Off-white used for all primary headings and nav text.
Pure white used for body copy and descriptive paragraph text.
Warm terracotta-orange dominant color of the Mars planet hero image filling the right half of the viewport.
Muted steel blue from the rocket launch sky sections, part of the brand's visual atmosphere.
Transparent/very dark navy overlay state of the navigation bar at top of page.
Solid black background of the navigation bar after scrolling.
Off-white text color used for navigation links in both overlay and scrolled states.
Off-white navigation link color maintained in the scrolled/opaque nav state.
Off-white used as the border and label color for the outlined primary CTA buttons (EXPLORE, ORDER NOW, LEARN MORE).
Dark gray used for subdued UI elements and secondary button backgrounds.
Dark gray border color used on outlined button components against black backgrounds.
Very dark navy-black used as the footer bar background.
